post.summary: Register a customer account
post.description: Creates a user with the Customer role. Internal roles are assigned by an administrator.

post.summary: Log in with e-mail and password
post.description: Returns a JWT access token (15 min) and a single-use refresh token (7 days). Any failure (unknown e-mail, wrong password, locked out account) returns the same 401.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: The refresh token is single-use: it is replaced by the returned one. Reusing an already exchanged token revokes the whole session (401), except for a repeated request within a few seconds (concurrent tabs), which gets another valid token. Unknown, expired and revoked tokens return 401.

post.summary: Log out (revoke the refresh token and its session)
post.description: Needs no access token, so it works after the access token expired. Returns 204 even for unknown or already revoked tokens. Already issued access tokens stay valid until they expire (max. 15 min).

post.summary: Request a password reset link by e-mail
post.description: Always returns 202, whether or not the e-mail belongs to an account. The link is valid for 1 hour.

post.summary: Set a new password with the token from the reset link
post.description: Unknown e-mail, wrong or expired token all return the same 400. A new password that violates the policy returns 400 on newPassword. On success all sessions (refresh tokens) are revoked.

get.description: Filters: type, active (true offers only active components, as quotes need), q (code, name, manufacturer). Ordered by type name and component name.

post.summary: Create a component (active)

put.description: A price change affects only quotes created afterwards: quotes keep the price they were issued with.

post.summary: Deactivate a component (no longer offered in quotes)
Activate a component
Create a connection request for an installation (state Draft)
post.description: Requires the single-line diagram and the owner's consent as attachments. Attachments may carry base64 content (stored and downloadable) or metadata only; at most 10 attachments of 5 MB, request body up to 66 MB. Type is SmallSource up to 10.8 kW rated AC power, otherwise LargeSource.

get.description: Filters: installationId, customerId, state. Newest first. A customer sees only its own requests.

get.summary: Get a connection request with its attachments

put.summary: Replace the EIC, power, breaker and attachments of a Draft request
put.description: Only a request in state Draft can be edited; anything else gives 409. The installation stays the same.

get.summary: Download the content of one attachment
get.description: Only attachments sent with base64 content can be downloaded; metadata-only attachments give 404.

post.summary: Create a contract (state Draft) from an accepted quote
post.description: Copies customer, lines and prices from the quote and assigns a unique number. A quote that is not Accepted, or that already has a contract, gives 409.

get.description: Filters: customerId, quoteId, status. Newest first.

get.summary: Get a contract with its lines and totals

post.summary: Record the signature (Draft to Signed) and create the installation
post.description: Needs the supply point of the installation. The installation starts in state Planned; it cannot move to ComponentsOrdered until the deposit is paid. Only a draft contract can be signed (409 otherwise).

post.summary: Record the paid deposit of a signed contract
post.description: Only a signed contract; the deposit can be recorded once (409 otherwise). Amount is in EUR, at most the contract total.

get.summary: Audit trail of the contract (created, signed, deposit paid), oldest first

post.summary: Create a customer (person or company)

get.description: Filter q matches name, company, e-mail, phone and IČO (case-insensitive substring). Ordered by surname / company name by default; sortBy = name | email | createdAt, sortDir = asc | desc. Defaults: page 1, pageSize 20 (max 100).

post.summary: Archive a customer
Reactivate an archived customer
Request a PV design for a customer's supply point (status Requested)

get.summary: List designs, optionally filtered by status, customer or supply point
Get a design with its roof and consumption parameters

post.summary: Record the site survey result (Requested → SiteSurveyDone)
Mark the site as not feasible (SiteSurveyDone → Infeasible)

put.summary: Set roof planes, consumption and location (SiteSurveyDone/InDesign → InDesign)

post.summary: Check panel/inverter compatibility and estimate annual yield without saving
Save the configuration as a new immutable version (400 when incompatible, 409 when the design is not InDesign)

get.summary: List saved configuration versions, newest first

get.description: By default only installed devices; includeReplaced=true adds replaced ones. Filter: type (Panel, Inverter).

post.summary: Register a panel or inverter with its serial number
post.description: The serial number is unique across all installations (case-insensitive), otherwise 409. Not possible after the installation has been handed over.

get.description: The whole chain of devices the given one belongs to (replaced predecessors and successors), oldest first.

post.summary: Replace an installed device with a new one, keeping the old one in history
post.description: The new device has the same type. The replaced device stays with status Replaced. 409 when the device has been replaced already or the new serial number is taken.

get.description: Filters: state, customerId, contractId, supplyPointId, assignedToMe (installations of the current technician).

post.summary: Create an installation for a contract and supply point (state Planned)

get.summary: Get an installation with its state history

put.summary: Update name, planned power and note
Replace the assigned technicians (users with role Technician)

post.summary: Change the installation state
post.description: Only transitions listed in allowedTransitions are accepted, otherwise 409. Mounting requires a schedule and at least one technician.

post.summary: Create a quote (state Draft) from catalog components
post.description: Send customerId and lines (componentId, quantity). Prices are taken from the catalog and copied into the quote; net, VAT and gross totals are computed by the server. Inactive components and archived customers give 409.

get.summary: Get a quote with its lines and totals

post.summary: Send the quote to the customer (Draft to Sent)
post.description: Optional body: validityDays (1 to 365, default 30) and note. The quote expires when the validity ends.

post.summary: Record that the customer accepted the quote (Sent to Accepted)
post.description: A quote past its validity is refused with 409 and marked Expired.

post.summary: Record that the customer rejected the quote (Sent to Rejected)

get.summary: Status change history of the quote, oldest first
List the supply points of a customer

post.summary: Add a supply point to a customer
post.description: A customer can have several supply points. The EIC code must have a valid format and be unique (409 otherwise).

delete.description: Returns 409 when an installation, FVE design or connection request uses the supply point.

get.summary: Get API name, version and environment

get.description: Filter q matches e-mail (case-insensitive substring). Ordered by e-mail. Defaults: page 1, pageSize 20 (max 100).

put.summary: Set the roles of a user
put.description: Replaces the complete set of roles (a user may have several); roles missing from the request are removed. Role names are case-insensitive. The last administrator cannot lose Admin (409). The change appears in the JWT issued by the next login or refresh (the current access token lives up to 15 min).

Metadata of one attachment, optionally with the file content. When string? AttachmentRequest.ContentBase64 is empty, only

supplyPointId.description: Supply point (odberné miesto) the design is bound to.
